attendance_confirmed.title: Attendance Confirmed
attendance_confirmed.description: Only records backed by a hospital attendance record. Recommended/planned referrals and household visits are never counted here.

referral_ids.title: Referral Ids
referral_ids.description: Restrict to these records (e.g. an offline device's local set).

clinically_validated.title: Clinically Validated
clinically_validated.description: Always false until a qualified reviewer approves the ruleset against approved protocols.

acknowledged.title: Acknowledged
acknowledged.description: True only after the server committed the operation. Anything else: keep the change pending on the device.

create_followup_task.title: Create Followup Task
create_followup_task.description: When completing with followup_required and next_followup_date, create the next PLANNED visit.
